$comment: The colours that may stay outside the role tokens (SECRT-3154): artwork, logos, brand marks, chart series, user-picked colour palettes, and markup that never reaches the app's stylesheet.
files: a glob from autogpt_platform/frontend. allow: only these palette classes (no variant or opacity) and hex values may stay in the file; without it, the whole file may keep its colours.

design-system/no-raw-palette-classes and no-hex-colours read this list, and scripts/__tests__/colour-exempt.test.ts checks every entry still matches a file and every allowed value is still used. Add an entry only with a reason.

exempt.reason: The token file: the one place a colour value is written.
Tailwind 3's reset, vendored unchanged; its border and placeholder greys are overridden by globals.css.
The expert colour picker: each option is a Tailwind 3 hue a person picks, saved with the expert (its id names the hue), written as that hue's hex, and its dither ramp.
Folder colours are user-picked data (blue, purple, emerald, orange, pink), drawn as folder artwork.
The folder colours a person can pick, stored as hex on the folder.
Sticky-note colours are user-picked data, one pastel per note.
The overview's "don't" examples, shown as code: they name raw colours on purpose.
Sample artifacts (HTML with the Tailwind CDN, SVG images) that the artifact iframe renders: content a person's Otto session produced, not the app's UI.
Notion-style avatar artwork: the generated SVG parts, their palette and the status badge drawn into the avatar.
Empty-state illustrations: fixed artwork palettes.
The AutoGPT logo's brand colours.
The glass orb artwork's colour blobs.
Confetti particle colours: canvas artwork.
The dither shader's colour ramp, uploaded to WebGL as numbers.
Otto's avatar aura artwork.
The greeting orb artwork's purple, drawn on a canvas.
The memory graph canvas: node and edge series colours drawn by the canvas renderer, where CSS variables do not resolve.
Chart series colours, written by recharts as SVG attributes, where CSS variables do not resolve.
Chart series colours, written by recharts as SVG attributes, where CSS variables do not resolve.
Chart series colours and the bar separator, written by recharts as SVG attributes, where CSS variables do not resolve.
The activity chart's two series colours (see ActivityChart.tsx).
The generated fallback avatar's artwork palette (boring-avatars).
The warm studio colour baked into the cover artwork, so the panel meets the image without a seam.
Stops of the spinner's CSS mask: alpha, not colour.
The fallback background and text of the dark syntax-highlighting theme, used until shiki has highlighted the block.
The HTML document the React artifact iframe loads: it has no access to the app's stylesheet.
A standalone HTML page the OAuth popup shows: it has no access to the app's stylesheet.
The tour's scripted sample documents: their support-ticket numbers (#4821, #4822, ...) read as hex, and none is a colour.
